_about: Art method r3 pilot P4 (FFX-2 only, chapter 6 Leblanc): the hurt bake's joint rotations, in idle.png pixel coordinates (before padding). Positive angles turn clockwise on screen: she faces left, the hit comes from the party on the left, so she recoils back to the right. METHOD-CHECK step 3: upper body back 10 to 14 degrees about the hips, head back 8 to 12, fan arm down 20 to 30.
_v2: P6 re-run after the first look: v1 (theta1 11, theta2 10, theta3 +22 outward) swung the fan upright beside the head, which read as a raised fan, not a hit; the blurred head weight sheared the hair outline. v2: 13 / 11 / -18 (the fan drops off the lips toward the chin), rigid head and core inside grown masks, the fan's convex hull in the arm layer. After a look at v2 with -18: the fan covered the heart mark (an identity mark), and hair tips outside SAM's head mask tore off; -10 and a hair box. Then the head weight's edge was narrower than the head's displacement, so the map folded and hair tips were copied into the background: headSigma 18, headGrow 20, coreSigma 16. The remaining fold was the neck ramp (20 px tall while the far hair tips rise 15 px): neckRamp -5..45.
